snippet.title: Haboku: a 6×6 Kakuro, solved in under a minute
snippet.description:
A 6×6 Medium puzzle in Haboku, played on a phone held sideways, with the game's own music and sound. Running sums beside each clue show what a run adds up to so far, and notes go in the corners of a square.

Music: GWriterStudio

Haboku is Kakuro, the number puzzle also known as cross sums. It's on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uk.tiggertoo.haboku
